mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the group of people who are held accountable for the activities of the co-operative."
The management committee is the group of people who are held accountable for the activities of the co-operative.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an entity which the law regards as having rights and duties."
A legal person is an entity which the law regards as having rights and duties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a key role on any management committee."
Chairing is a key role on any management committee.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a body of politicians representing particular territories or interests."
The legislature is a body of politicians representing particular territories or interests.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called General Manager because his functions are similar to the functions performed by a General Manager of a private undertaking."
The Chief Executive is called General Manager because his functions are similar to the functions performed by a General Manager of a private undertaking.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for making sure that each meeting is planned effectively, concluded according to the constitutions and that matters are dealth with in an orderly, efficient manner."
The Chairperson is responsible for making sure that each meeting is planned effectively, concluded according to the constitutions and that matters are dealth with in an orderly, efficient manner.
fib: ______ is a debt only when it is declared and due for payment.
A dividend is a debt only when it is declared and due for payment.
______ refers to those cooperative laws that have been in force in Nigeria.
Principal legislation in Nigeria cooperatives refers to those cooperative laws that have been in force in Nigeria.
______ is the point of origin for law or legal analysis.
A source of law is the point of origin for law or legal analysis.
______ are the body of persons who actually run the administration.
Personnel are the body of persons who actually run the administration.
______ is the application and translation of the subsidiary to a specific cooperative society.
Cooperative by-laws is the application and translation of the subsidiary to a specific cooperative society.
